Plot SpatRaster and SpatVector Objects

Source: R/plot.R
plot.SpatRaster.Rd

S3 plot methods for terra::SpatRaster and terra::SpatVector objects, ensuring that plot(r) works seamlessly when rpisco is loaded, even if library(terra) has not been explicitly attached.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'SpatRaster'
plot(x, y, ...)

# S3 method for class 'SpatVector'
plot(x, y, ...)

Arguments

x

A terra::SpatRaster or terra::SpatVector object.

y

Optional second argument for bivariate plotting in terra.

...

Additional graphical parameters forwarded to terra::plot().

Value

Invisibly returns the plotted object or NULL, creating a plot on the active device.
